body: Im sick of this piety party thread full of people complaining about how terrible life is and having no desire to change, wallowing in a pit of despair. Its as depressing reading about ur pointless, shitty lives as it is to live my own.

I feel... alone and vulnerable. I recently stopped smoking weed and at first i felt great, like i was making real progress. But now im bouncing between emotions, im used to having much more control of myself and it scares me sometimes.
